result.keywords: We derive new bounds for entanglement-assisted quantum maximum distance separable codes and their associated highly entangled subspaces, combining techniques from matrix-product constructions and shadow inequalities. The results interpolate between stabilizer QMDS code limits and multipartite entanglement constraints, and we provide weight-distribution estimates for families with distance at least three. Our analysis extends known quantum MDS-type bounds to the entanglement-assisted setting and yields additional existence criteria for subspaces with uniform reduced density operators.
result.publisher: Verein zur Forderung des Open Access Publizierens in den Quantenwissenschaften
result.title: Entanglement-Assisted Bounds for General Quantum MDS Subspaces
